Package org.apache.juneau.examples.mcp

Class ExampleClient

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.examples.mcp.ExampleClient
public final class ExampleClient extends Object
A guided, end-to-end walkthrough of every ExampleMcpServer surface using the v2 McpClient.

Run main (optionally passing the server endpoint; defaults to http://localhost:5000/) after starting ExampleServer. Each numbered step prints what it is doing and what it got back, so the transcript reads top-to-bottom like a tutorial.

The client advertises the elicitation capability, which the server requires before it will pause a call for input; without it the deleteNote elicitation step would be rejected.

Console output caveat: every printed line below is produced by re-serializing the already-parsed response bean with Json.of(...), purely for readable console output. That re-serialization drops the polymorphic content-block "type" discriminator (e.g. "text"/"audio") the real wire format carries, so what you see here is not byte-for-byte what came off the wire.
